title: 第10章 灵气感知课上的活靶子
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
周二下午，灵气感知课。

    选修课的教室在教学楼东侧的附属楼里，空间比普通教室大了一倍，四面墙壁镶嵌着灵气引导阵纹，淡蓝色的光芒若隐若现。

    安槐和苏念念走进来的时候，教室里已经坐了二十来个人，这门课是跨班选修，从全年级各班抽人，安槐扫了一眼，认识的面孔不多。

    苏念念很快挑好了位置，靠前排偏左。

    “坐这儿，老师演示的时候看得清楚。”

    安槐点头坐下。

    后排传来一阵窃窃私私的声音，混着几声“是安槐”“全年级第一”之类的关键词，安槐充耳不闻，翻开课本。

    苏念念倒是坐得笔直，环顾了一圈教室，忽然嘴角一歪。

    “嘿，你猜谁来了。”

    安槐抬头。

    教室后门口，林落雪抱着课本走了进来。

    她穿着校服外套，长发用一个素色发夹别在耳后，怯生生地在教室里扫了一圈，目光在安槐和苏念念这边停了不到一秒，然后安安静静地坐到了中间靠后的位置。

    安槐收回目光，翻了一页课本。

    【巧了不是？林落雪同样选了周二的灵气感知课。巧合次数加一，当前计数：1。宿主你的风控模型要不要更新一下？】

    “一次不能说明问题。”

    【行，那我帮你盯着，第二次出现的时候我提醒你。】

    苏念念没注意到安槐的微妙表情变化，她正伸着脖子往前看，研究讲台上摆着的几个水晶球状的器具。

    “那些是什么？”

    “灵气感知测量器。”安槐瞥了一眼，“用来检测感知范围和敏锐度的。”

    “你怎么知道的？”

    “课本第三页写了。”

    苏念念低头翻了翻课本第三页，上面画着一模一样的器具图。

    她默默合上课本。

    “我不跟你说话了。”

    上课铃响，走进来的老师是个瘦高个女人，三十来岁，眼神锐利，一头利落的短发，身上的气息波动比方远还沉，通脉初期。

    “我叫宋澜，负责灵气感知课，废话不多说，先做个摸底。”

    她从讲台上拿起一个水晶球，灵气灌入，球体内部亮起一团柔和的光。

    “每人上来摸一次这个球，球体会根据你的灵气感知天赋显示颜色，白色最低，蓝色中等，紫色优秀，金色……呵，我教了六年，还没见过。”

    学生们挨个上去，大部分人的球体亮起白色，偶尔有蓝色的，引来一片小声惊叹。

    苏念念被叫到名字，大步走上去。

    她把手放在球上，球体先是白光一闪，两秒后变成了稳定的蓝色，而且蓝得很深，几乎逼近紫色的边缘。

    宋澜挑了一下眉毛。

    “不错，上品蓝，苏家的功法底子打得好，坐下。”

    苏念念嘴角翘着回来，在安槐面前晃了晃手指。

    “看到没？上品蓝。”

    安槐朝她竖起大拇指。

    “安槐。”宋澜念到了他的名字。

    安槐站起来，走上讲台。

    他把右手放在水晶球表面，球体内部的光芒瞬间跳过白色和蓝色，紫光大盛，充满整个球体。

    教室里的嗡嗡声一下子消失了。

    紫色。

    宋澜的眼睛微微睁大了一点，随即恢复平静。
content_en:
Tuesday afternoon, Reiki Sensing class.

The elective course classroom is in the annex building on the east side of the teaching building. The space is twice as large as an ordinary classroom. The four walls are inlaid with spiritual energy guidance patterns, and a light blue light is looming.

When An Huai and Su Niannian walked in, there were already about twenty people sitting in the classroom. This course was a cross-class elective, and students were drawn from all classes in the grade. An Huai glanced at it and saw that he didn't recognize many faces.

Su Niannian quickly picked a seat, near the front row and to the left.

"Sit here so you can see clearly when the teacher demonstrates."

An Huai nodded and sat down.

There was a burst of murmurs from the back row, mixed with keywords such as "It's An Huai" and "No. 1 in the grade". An Huai turned a deaf ear and opened the textbook.

Su Niannian sat up straight, looked around the classroom, and suddenly the corner of her mouth curled up.

"Hey, guess who's here."

An Huai raised his head.

At the back door of the classroom, Lin Luoxue walked in holding textbooks.

She was wearing a school uniform jacket, with her long hair tied behind her ears with a plain hairpin. She timidly glanced around the classroom, her eyes stopping at An Huai and Su Niannian for less than a second, and then she sat quietly in the middle and back.

An Huai looked back and turned a page in the textbook.

[What a coincidence, isn’t it?Lin Luoxue also chose the aura perception class on Tuesday.The number of coincidences increases by one, current count: 1.Do you want to update your risk control model?】

“One time doesn’t tell the story.”

[Okay, then I'll keep an eye on it for you, and I'll remind you when it appears the second time.】

Su Niannian didn't notice the subtle changes in An Huai's expression. She was stretching her neck to look forward, studying several crystal ball-shaped instruments placed on the podium.

"What are those?"

"Aura perception measuring device." An Huai glanced at it, "used to test the range and acuity of perception."

"How do you know?"

"It's written on the third page of the textbook."

Su Niannian lowered her head and flipped through the third page of the textbook, where there were identical pictures of utensils.

She closed the textbook silently.

"I won't talk to you anymore."

The school bell rang, and the teacher who walked in was a tall and thin woman, in her thirties, with sharp eyes and neat short hair. The aura fluctuations on her body were heavier than Fang Yuan's, and she was in the early stage of channeling.

"My name is Song Lan, and I'm in charge of the spiritual energy perception class. Without further ado, let's do some basic research first."

She picked up a crystal ball from the podium, poured spiritual energy into it, and a soft light lit up inside the ball.

"Everyone comes up and touches this ball once. The color of the ball will be displayed according to your spiritual energy perception talent. White is the lowest, blue is medium, purple is excellent, and gold... Hehe, I have been teaching for six years and I have never seen it before."

The students went up one by one, and most of their spheres lit up white, and occasionally blue, which attracted a small exclamation.

When Su Niannian's name was called, she strode up.

She put her hand on the ball. The ball first flashed with white light, and after two seconds it turned into a stable blue, and the blue was very deep, almost approaching the edge of purple.

Song Lan raised her eyebrows.

"Yes, top grade blue. The Su family has a good foundation in martial arts. Sit down."

Su Niannian came back with the corner of her mouth raised, wagging her finger in front of An Huai.

"See? Fine blue."

An Huai gave her a thumbs up.

"An Huai." Song Lan read his name.

An Huai stood up and walked onto the podium.

He placed his right hand on the surface of the crystal ball, and the light inside the ball instantly jumped from white to blue, and the purple light flourished, filling the entire ball.

The buzz in the classroom suddenly disappeared.

Purple.

Song Lan's eyes opened slightly, and then calmed down.
title_en: Chapter 10 A living target in the aura perception class
